five_percent_research_diagnostic.allowed_interpretation: This is a negative/positive screen only inside a retrospective close-price proxy. It cannot prove stable performance, investor return, personal access, implementation quality or a future result.
failures: At least one complete calendar-year market-price proxy is below 5%.
At least one rolling-five-year market-price proxy is below 5%.

paper_trade_cost.boundary: Illustrative recurrence only; not an observed fee, tax, bid/ask, impact, fill, settlement or capacity measure.

fixed_rule.signal: On each calendar-month final common close, compare each sleeve value with the close 252 common observations earlier; positive means greater than zero.
fixed_rule.target: Equal weight among positive equity, bond and gold sleeves; if none is positive, 100% 511990 fallback.
fixed_rule.timing: A signal formed after the month-end close applies no earlier than the next common trading session, before that session's proxy close-to-close movement.

hard_limitations: The official SSE responses were captured retrospectively; they do not establish point-in-time availability, revisions, data rights or an adjusted total-return series.
Daily close is not a tradable fill and omits distributions, fund events, NAV/IOPV, bid/ask, depth, price limits, suspensions, fees, taxes, settlement, account eligibility and no-fill outcomes.
This rule was fixed after related public observations existed; it is not a clean preregistration and cannot support an out-of-sample performance claim.
A five-percent screen does not turn a long-run target into a minimum return, and the result does not authorize an external action.

turnover_and_cost_summary.boundary: The simple sum is not a compounded result or an executable-cost estimate.
